name: core-ecommerce
description: Core E-Commerce Checkout con motor de descuentos acumulativos - Prueba técnica Especialista I Open Banking

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cross-env PORT=8080 npm run dev -w @core-ecommerce/backend" "npm run dev -w @core-ecommerce/frontend"
